Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon built a 3D periodic table synced to Tom Lehrer’s song, “The Elements.” Created in @Antigravity, it animates orbiting electrons, atomic data, and light spectra.
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 构建了一个与 Tom Lehrer 的歌曲《The Elements》同步的 3D 元素周期表。该作品在 @Antigravity 中创建，可动画展示绕轨电子、原子数据和光谱。

items.title: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft from scratch in 27 hours. Operating in a sandbox using only code and text, they wrote 2,783 programs, divided up jobs over chat, shared notes, and debugged errors together - all with no human help ↓
items.title_zh: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体在 27 小时内从零开始通关 Minecraft。它们在沙盒中仅使用代码和文本运行，编写了 2,783 个程序，通过聊天分配任务、共享笔记并共同调试错误——全程无人工帮助 ↓

items.title: We're open sourcing SPACE, the sandbox platform that runs every task in Perplexity Computer. SPACE gives each agent task its own Firecracker microVM and controls credentials and outbound traffic from outside the VM. Available now under Apache 2.0:
items.title_zh: 我们正在开源 SPACE，这是运行 Perplexity Computer 中每项任务的沙盒平台。SPACE 为每个智能体任务提供独立的 Firecracker microVM，并从 VM 外部控制凭据和出站流量。现已在 Apache 2.0 许可下提供：

items.title: Perplexity Computer can now run fully local on your Mac. Work with your native Mac apps and local files, and run tasks without sending sensitive data to the cloud. The model and the agent both run on your Mac. Available now in the Perplexity Mac app.
items.title_zh: Perplexity Computer 现在可以在你的 Mac 上完全本地运行。使用原生 Mac 应用和本地文件，运行任务时无需将敏感数据发送到云端。模型和智能体都在你的 Mac 上运行。现已在 Perplexity Mac 应用中提供。

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon combined three open-source datasets to build an interactive 3D visualization of human anatomy. Toggle different layers in motion, isolate muscles, or zoom inside a beating heart.
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 结合三个开源数据集，构建了人体解剖学的交互式 3D 可视化。可动态切换不同图层、单独显示肌肉，或放大进入跳动的心脏内部。

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon sets a new record on WANDR. It is now available in Perplexity for Pro and Max subscribers.
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 在 WANDR 上创下新纪录。现已在 Perplexity 中向 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户提供。

items.title: SynthID has been named one of @TIME's Best Inventions of 2026. With over 180 billion images and videos already watermarked, it’s making it easier for people to distinguish AI-generated content from other media →
items.title_zh: SynthID 被评为 @TIME 2026 年度最佳发明之一。已有超过 1800 亿张图片和视频添加水印，帮助人们更轻松地区分 AI 生成内容与其他媒体 →

items.title: NVIDIA’s Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is now available in Perplexity for Pro and Max subscribers, and in Agent API.
items.title_zh: NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 现已在 Perplexity 中向 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户提供，并已在 Agent API 中提供。

items.title: Local tasks use PPLX Pro, our post-trained version of Qwen 3.8, and don't consume Computer credits. For more complex work, Hybrid can split the task between a cloud models and a local model on your Mac, keeping sensitive data private. Read more:
items.title_zh: 本地任务使用 PPLX Pro（我们后训练的 Qwen 3.8 版本），不消耗 Computer 额度。对于更复杂的工作，Hybrid 模式可将任务拆分到云端模型和你的 Mac 上的本地模型之间，确保敏感数据保持私密。了解更多：

items.title: Agents in Computer run commands, install packages, and call external services with root access inside the sandbox. The host stays outside the guest's control, and a per-sandbox gateway enforces egress policy on every outbound connection.
items.title_zh: Computer 中的智能体在沙盒内以 root 权限运行命令、安装软件包并调用外部服务。宿主机不受客户机控制，每个沙盒的网关会对每个出站连接强制执行出口策略。
